name: eighteen-cosmos-server
description: Authoritative game server. Hosts RoomSession over WebSocket; decides nothing itself (design note #1210).

scripts._comment_build: INVOKED THROUGH `node`, NOT THROUGH THE .bin SHIM, AND THE REASON IS WINDOWS. `.bin/tsc` is a shell script; cmd.exe reads `../frontend/...` as a command it does not have and answers `'..' is not recognized`. `node <path>/bin/tsc` is the same compiler reached in a way every shell agrees about. Same family of fault as the `FOO=1 npm start` note in src/start.ts: an instruction that works for half its readers.
